svg.text: Dead Line v2 - Area 1 Approach: Cable Lane (plan, ground level)
D0 draft 2026-10-10. 1 m = 10 px, grid 6 m. Coordinates (x east, z north) in metres from the lane mouth. Detection numbers are checked in D1, not here.
RAILWAY VIADUCT - brick, 12 m deep, deck +7.0 (trains above); arches 10 m pitch, piers 2 m
lean-to roofs +3.0 front, +3.6 at arch; felt; 0.3 m party upstands
The Linesman pub (back): yard wall 2.4 m, glass coping
Hollowmere printing works (3 storeys, closed at night; high barred windows on the lane)
Mill Street back yards: walls 2.4 m with glass coping, locked timber yard doors (no way through)
(sniper on A block roof, off plan to the SE, +14 m)
Section A-A along the lane centreline (vertical scale as plan; y 0 = lane surface)
lean-to roof fronts +3.0 (beyond); gaps at A6 and A13

g.text: M1 shaft 1.2 x 1.2, fixed ladder 4.4 m
cable tunnel 1934: 2.4 high x 2.6 wide, cable bearers both walls, 1.8 m walkway, unlit (bulkheads off)
east section: no access from Area 1 (entered only from A block's cable chamber)
sealed supply-cable duct from the substation (off this line, not passable)
Below route (cable tunnel, M1 to M2)
Guard stop; red line = patrol; arrow = facing at the stop
Lamp and pool (dashed orange: cannot be switched or shot)
Hide spot H (1.2 x 1.0 or larger, dark)
Hold interaction (M1 4 s, FP1 3 s, van cab 2 s, M2 3 s, SG 3 s)
K = checkpoint, E = encounter, FX = printworks fire exit recess, DP = downpipe
GA1 to GA4: Area 1 guards (Pell's contractor). GB1 and SN: Area 2 guards whose views reach Area 1.
Rain all night. No guard has keys to the tunnel or the substation (telco property).
Lamps: CA1 council lane circuit (LA1, LA2, LA3, LA5) off at feeder pillar FP1; LA4 printworks photocell, caged;
LA6 substation (switch inside the switch room); LA7 exchange gate floodlight (gatehouse switch, Area 2).
